title: My Stapler Has Tenure
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I filed a form to request a form
To formally request a form
Brenda from Compliance said the form was warm
So we let the form sleep in the storm

[Chorus]
My stapler has tenure, my stapler has tenure
It outranks me, it out-earns me
My stapler has tenure and a corner view
And it will not be reviewed by you

title: Reply All (I Am So Sorry)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I meant to send it just to Doug
Instead I sent it to the globe
Four thousand people read my thoughts
About the smell of Terry's robe

[Chorus]
Reply all, reply all
I have ruined the entire hall
Reply all, reply all
Please recall, please recall, PLEASE RECALL

title: Bureaucracy (Extended Yawn)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Stamp, stamp, initial, stamp
I have been in this queue since I was a child
The clerk who greeted me is now a lamp
The lamp says my application has been filed

[Chorus]
Take a number, take a number
Take a number, take a nap
I took a number in the summer
It is winter and I'm still in this trap

title: Quarterly Feelings Review
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You said my sadness lacked alignment
You said my joy was off-brand
You gave my heartbreak a two out of five
And a plan for professional development

[Chorus]
Circle back, circle back
Let's take my grief offline
I'll be crying in the stairwell
From nine until nine-oh-nine

title: The Printer Knows What It Did
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
It jams when I am watching
It works when I am not
It printed forty copies of a man I've never met
Wearing nothing but a thought

[Chorus]
The printer knows, the printer knows
The printer knows what it did
It printed out my resignation
Before I even wrote the lid

title: Doug Took the Good Chair
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I went to lunch, I ate a bun
I came back and my chair was gone
Doug was in it, spinning slow
Doug looked at me and whispered "no"

[Chorus]
Doug took the good chair
Doug took the good chair
I got lumbar, Doug got glory
Doug took the good chair

title: Out of Office Forever
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I set my auto-reply to a poem
I set my auto-reply to a scream
I set my auto-reply to the sound of a door
Closing gently on a dream

[Chorus]
I am out of office, I am out of office
I will respond in the year of the whale
I am out of office, I am out of office
Please redirect your urgency to a snail

title: Onboarding, Day Nine Hundred
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They gave me a lanyard and a buddy
My buddy has retired
They gave me a mug that says "welcome aboard"
The ship, I'm told, expired

[Chorus]
Still onboarding, still onboarding
Still learning where the forks are kept
Still onboarding, still onboarding
I have onboarded and I have wept

title: Synergy Is a Type of Soup
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We aligned on the ask, we unpacked the lift
We took it offline and we let it drift
We circled the wagon, we boiled the ocean
We stirred the synergy with slow devotion

[Chorus]
Synergy is a type of soup
It has no beans, it has no broth
You cannot eat it with a spoon
But it will still stain your cloth

title: Mandatory Fun (Attendance Required)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They booked a room, they bought a cake
They said "be yourselves, but not like that"
There is a man in a vest with a clipboard
Measuring how much fun we've had

[Chorus]
Mandatory fun, mandatory fun
Smile for the survey, laugh on the hour
Mandatory fun, mandatory fun
The joy is scheduled and it lasts til four

title: You Microwaved the Fish
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
There were rules, unwritten, sacred
There were laws older than bread
You put a salmon in the box of light
And now the whole floor smells of dread

[Chorus]
You microwaved the fish
You microwaved the fish
Ninety seconds, one wish
Now we live inside the fish

title: Lasagna at Dawn
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Nobody eats lasagna at four in the morning
Nobody but me and the moon
I layer, I weep, I layer again
The béchamel forgives me soon

[Chorus]
Lasagna at dawn, lasagna at dawn
Nine layers deep and I'm not done
Lasagna at dawn, lasagna at dawn
I have become the noodle and the sun

title: Spaghetti in the Server Room
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I brought my dinner where the cables sleep
The fans were loud, the sauce was deep
A red strand fell on rack number three
And now the internet tastes like me

[Chorus]
Spaghetti in the server room
Spaghetti in the server room
We lost the database, we lost the bloom
But dinner was warm in the humming gloom

title: Hot Sauce on the Hymnal
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I sneezed at the moment of blessing
I was holding a bottle of flame
The hymnal is now a hot hymnal
And the choir will not say my name

[Chorus]
Hot sauce on the hymnal
Hot sauce on the pew
Forgive me, I am criminal
Verse two is burning through

title: The Soup Has Opinions
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I stirred it once, it stirred me back
I asked for salt, it asked for space
The soup has read my diary
The soup has seen my face

[Chorus]
The soup has opinions
The soup has a plan
The soup does not respect me
The soup is a man

title: Ninety-Nine Sandwiches, No Bread
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Got the ham, got the cheese, got the little bitter leaf
Got the mustard in a jar shaped like a grief
Got the pickle, got the onion, got the sauce that goes on top
Went to grab the bread and the bread had stopped

[Chorus]
Ninety-nine sandwiches, no bread
Ninety-nine sandwiches, no bread
I built them all inside my head
Ninety-nine sandwiches, no bread

title: My Sourdough Starter Left Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I named him Gary, I fed him flour
I sang to Gary every hour
I went to Reno for a weekend spree
Came back and Gary had moved to Tennessee

[Chorus]
My sourdough starter left me
Took the jar and took the towel
He rose without me, he rose without me
Now the kitchen's cold and foul

title: Do Not Refrigerate the Bananas
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I told you once, I told you twice
I told you in a note of rice
You opened the door, you slid them in
And now the fruit bowl weeps for kin

[Chorus]
Do not refrigerate the bananas
Do not refrigerate the pears
Do not refrigerate the bananas
Or the bananas will refrigerate yours

title: Toast Is a Lifestyle
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I have no career, I have a toaster
I have no plan, I have a slot
I lower the lever like a prayer
And I ask it what I've got

[Chorus]
Toast is a lifestyle, toast is a creed
Toast is the only thing I need
Brown on the outside, warm in the seed
Toast is a lifestyle, toast is a creed

title: The Casserole Incident of '87
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We do not speak of it at Christmas
We do not speak of it at all
There is a dish in Grandma's cupboard
That still faces the wall

[Chorus]
The casserole incident, the casserole incident
Nine cousins went in, seven came out
The casserole incident, the casserole incident
Nobody knows what it was about

title: My Landlord Is a Pigeon
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
He coos at me on the first of the month
He nods at the mailbox, he nods at the sill
I slide the rent beneath a paving stone
And he takes it in his little bill

[Chorus]
My landlord is a pigeon
My landlord is a bird
He has never fixed the boiler
And he's never said a word

title: Goose With a Briefcase
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
He walks through the terminal, gate twenty-nine
He does not have a ticket, he does not stand in line
Security waved him through with a nod of quiet fear
The goose has a meeting and the meeting is here

[Chorus]
Goose with a briefcase, goose with a plan
Goose with a briefcase, more employed than a man
Goose with a briefcase, don't look at his eyes
The goose is your manager now. Surprise.

title: The Ballad of Steve, a Cactus
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Steve don't move and Steve don't talk
Steve don't join us on the walk
But Steve has seen four marriages fail
And Steve has never told the tale

[Chorus]
Oh Steve, oh Steve, oh spiny friend
You'll outlive me and my extended kin
You need a thimble of water in the spring
And that's the only thing

title: Fourteen Ducks in a Trench Coat
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They came to the cinema, bought one ticket
They stood very tall, they stood very still
The usher said "sir, your coat is quacking"
The coat said "that is a personal skill"

[Chorus]
Fourteen ducks in a trench coat
Fourteen ducks, one dream
Fourteen ducks in a trench coat
Watching a film about a stream

title: I Owe a Raccoon Six Hundred Dollars
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
It was a loan, it was informal
He had the cash, I had the need
He shook my hand with a small grey hand
And we sealed it with a seed

[Chorus]
I owe a raccoon six hundred dollars
I owe a raccoon and he knows my street
He does not call, he does not holler
He just tips my bins to the beat

title: My Cat Has Started Invoicing Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Line item one: emotional labour
Line item two: the sitting on the lap
Line item three: consulting on the curtains
Line item four: a nap

[Chorus]
My cat has started invoicing me
Net thirty, no disputes
My cat has started invoicing me
And she's raised her rates for boots

title: The Horse Knows About the Money
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I hid it in the barn, I hid it in the hay
I hid it where the horse could not see
But the horse was watching from the corner of the stall
And the horse is watching me

[Chorus]
The horse knows about the money
The horse knows about the tin
The horse has told the other horses
And the other horses grin

title: Bees Have Ruined My Wedding (Again)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Third time lucky, third time stung
Third dress ruined, third bell rung
The vicar ran, the cake dissolved
The bees stayed on, the bees resolved

[Chorus]
Bees have ruined my wedding again
Bees have ruined my day
I have tried four venues in four counties
And the bees know the way

title: Sheep Do Not Forgive
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I counted them once to fall asleep
I miscounted, I skipped a sheep
Sheep number four has not forgotten
Sheep number four has gone rotten

[Chorus]
Sheep do not forgive, sheep do not forget
Sheep keep a ledger that is very wet
Sheep do not forgive, sheep do not move on
Sheep will be waiting when the light is gone

title: Dog Elected Mayor, Town Thrives
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
He ran on a platform of naps and of sticks
He promised a fountain, he built us six
The roads got smoother, the taxes got low
He cannot read but the numbers show

[Chorus]
Dog elected mayor, town thrives
Dog elected mayor, best day of our lives
He barks at the budget, he barks at the moon
Re-elect the dog in June

title: The Moon Owes Me Money
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I lent it to the moon in a generous year
The moon said "I'm good for it, do not fear"
That was eleven Novembers ago
And the moon just glows and glows and glows

[Chorus]
The moon owes me money
The moon owes me eight
The moon is a debtor
The moon is my mistake

title: Pluto Called, He's Fine
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
He said he's been meaning to text
He said the demotion was fine
He said he's got hobbies now, ceramics and ice
He said he's been feeling divine

[Chorus]
Pluto called, he's fine
Pluto called, don't fuss
Pluto says he never liked the meetings
And he's better off without us

title: I Parked My Rocket in a Meadow
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I came from beyond the seventh ring
To see if the grass was as soft as they sing
I landed at noon in a farmer's field
And the farmer said "move it" and the cows appealed

[Chorus]
I parked my rocket in a meadow
I parked it on a cow's good spot
I have crossed nine hundred galaxies
To be told where I may not

title: Astronaut, Wrong Address
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They gave me a suit and they gave me a seat
They gave me a number and a countdown beat
I typed the coordinates in a hurry that day
Now I'm orbiting a laundromat in a nebula grey

[Chorus]
Astronaut, wrong address
Astronaut, wrong star
I have gone incredibly far
To be incredibly not where you are

title: Black Hole in the Utility Room
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
It started as a stain by the washing machine
It ate a sock, then it ate the sheen
The plumber came out and he scratched his head
And then the plumber was extremely dead

[Chorus]
Black hole in the utility room
Black hole where the mop should be
It's taken the boiler and the ironing board
And it's coming for the boiler's memory

title: Comet, Slow Down
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You come around once every eighty years
You don't call, you don't write
You blaze across the whole of the sky
And you're gone before the night

[Chorus]
Comet, slow down, comet, slow down
You are always leaving, always leaving town
Comet, slow down, comet, be kind
I have aged and you have not and I do not mind

title: Mars Has a Landlord Too
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Two hundred million miles from the lease I fled
Signed a new one on a rock that's red
The deposit was a moon, the agent was a drone
And the drone says the dust is on me alone

[Chorus]
Mars has a landlord too
Mars has a fee
You can leave the whole planet, friend
But you cannot leave the fee

title: Gravity Is a Suggestion
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I read the terms and conditions of the sky
I found a clause on the ninetieth page
It said the falling is technically optional
If you are polite and of age

[Chorus]
Gravity is a suggestion
Gravity is a vibe
I have politely declined it
And I'm floating over Clyde

title: The Satellite Is Lonely
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
It photographs a car park every ninety minutes
It has done so since nineteen eighty-one
It knows every crack in the tarmac by name
It has never been thanked by anyone

[Chorus]
The satellite is lonely
The satellite is cold
The satellite has seen your rooftop
Grow beautifully old

title: Alien Arrives, Asks for Terry
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The ship came down on the village green
The door came open with a hiss of steam
A being stepped out, nine feet of light
And said "is Terry in tonight?"

[Chorus]
Alien arrives, asks for Terry
Alien arrives, will not say why
Terry's at his sister's until Tuesday
And the alien has agreed to wait outside

title: Dave Won't Return the Ladder
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Spring of two thousand and four
He knocked upon my kitchen door
"Just for the weekend," Dave had said
Dave's children now are fully bred

[Chorus]
Dave won't return the ladder
Dave won't return the rake
Dave has built a life upon my ladder
Dave, for heaven's sake

title: I Married a Traffic Cone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
She stood on the roadworks, orange and proud
She never complained, she never got loud
I asked her father, a barrier of steel
He said nothing at all, which I took as a deal

[Chorus]
I married a traffic cone
We honeymooned on the A9
She's the only one who's ever stood there
Reliably, rain or shine

title: The Hedge Is Winning
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I trimmed it Tuesday, it grew by Thursday
I trimmed it Friday, it grew by Friday
I stood there with the shears at midnight
And the hedge stood back and said "hi"

[Chorus]
The hedge is winning, the hedge is tall
The hedge has taken the garden wall
The hedge is winning, the hedge is fed
The hedge will attend my funeral instead

title: Aggressively Normal
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
My lawn is a rectangle, my car is a grey
I own two identical cardigans
I say "not too bad" when they ask about my day
And I mean it, that's the tragedy, I mean it

[Chorus]
Aggressively normal, aggressively fine
Aggressively holding the beige party line
Aggressively normal, aggressively me
The most unremarkable man in the sea

title: Roundabout of Broken Dreams
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I missed my exit, I'll go round again
I missed my exit, I'll go round again
I missed my exit, I'll go round again
The petrol's low but the loop is clean

[Chorus]
Roundabout, roundabout
I've been circling since half past two
Roundabout, roundabout
I have seen that garden centre eleven times, and so have you

title: The Bins Go Out on Which Day
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Green on Monday, brown on the third
Blue when the council has said the word
Black is a mystery, black is a myth
Black went out once and it never came with

[Chorus]
The bins go out on which day, which day
Nobody living can say
The bins go out on which day, which day
The schedule is a work of decay

title: Neighbour Built a Second House Inside His House
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Planning permission? He did not seek it
Structural survey? He would not speak it
There's a front door in his living room
And a smaller front door in the smaller room

[Chorus]
House in the house in the house, my guy
Recursive architecture, ask him why
He says it's for the guests, he says it's for the view
The view is of a house. Inside a house. Inside you.

title: Sold the Car to a Man Named Cliff
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Cliff had cash and Cliff had charm
Cliff had a handshake like a farm
Cliff drove off and Cliff drove far
Cliff, it turns out, was three kids in a car

[Chorus]
Sold the car to a man named Cliff
Cliff was not a man
Cliff was an idea three children had
And Cliff had a plan

title: Barbecue Under a Cloud
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The forecast said a nine percent chance
The forecast lied with a smiling glance
I lit the coals, I raised the tongs
And the sky performed its wettest songs

[Chorus]
Barbecue under a cloud
Barbecue in the rain
Twelve guests under one umbrella
Eating sausages of pain

title: My Driveway, My Kingdom
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Eleven feet of honest tarmac
Bordered by a decorative stone
I did not choose this land, it chose me
And I rule it alone

[Chorus]
My driveway, my kingdom
My driveway, my throne
Park across it if you dare, stranger
And discover what I've grown

title: Ceiling Fan Romance
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
She turns and turns above my bed
She never once has turned her head
Three speeds of love, and I choose two
Because at three she's over you

[Chorus]
Ceiling fan romance
Slow and cool and high
She'll never come down to me
But she'll never say goodbye

title: My Toaster Is Judging Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
It knows how many slices, it knows the hour
It knows I said "just one" and then had four
It has a little dial and a little sigh
And a little way of looking at the floor

[Chorus]
My toaster is judging me
My toaster has a view
My toaster has forgiven bread
But it has not forgiven you

title: The Lamp and I Have History
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We met in a shop on a Saturday
It was forty percent off and lonely
I took it home and I plugged it in
And it lit me, only me, only

[Chorus]
The lamp and I have history
The lamp and I have lore
The lamp has seen my worst decade
And it lights me even more

title: Sock Drawer Apocalypse
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
It began with one grey stranger
No partner, no known kin
Then a second, then a legion
Then the drawer would not close in

[Chorus]
Sock drawer apocalypse
Sock drawer at war
There are ninety-one socks in there
And matching pairs: four

title: I Love You, Kettle
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You scream when you're ready, which is honest
You stop when you're done, which is rare
You have never once pretended
That you wanted to be elsewhere

[Chorus]
I love you, kettle
I love you, spout
You are the only thing in this house
That says exactly what it's about

title: The Chair That Understood
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
It creaked in sympathy, not in age
It leaned back when I leaned back
It held me through a decade of afternoons
And it never once asked "so what's the plan, Jack?"

[Chorus]
The chair that understood
The chair that never spoke
The chair that took my whole weight
When everything else broke

title: Umbrella, You Coward
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
One gust, one gust, that's all it took
You turned inside out like a badly written book
Eight little ribs and a plastic sleeve
And a promise you had no intent to keep

[Chorus]
Umbrella, you coward
Umbrella, you fraud
You had one job in all the world
And you gave it up to God

title: Ode to a Fridge Magnet from Wales
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You cost two pounds in a coastal shop
You are shaped like a sheep in a hat
You have held up a takeaway menu since 2009
And there is nothing more heroic than that

[Chorus]
Ode to a fridge magnet from Wales
Ode to a very small sheep
You have outlasted three relationships
And you did it in your sleep

title: The Remote Is Under Something
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
It is not under the cushion, I have been there
It is not under the dog, I have asked
It is under something, that much is certain
And that something is masked

[Chorus]
The remote is under something
The remote is under there
The remote is under something
That is all we know. That is all we'll ever share.

title: I Have Named My Vacuum Gerald
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Gerald works the night shift, Gerald never sleeps
Gerald knows the corners where the cereal creeps
Gerald hit a cable and Gerald hit a shoe
Gerald hit my ankle and Gerald knew, Gerald knew

[Chorus]
I have named my vacuum Gerald
Gerald is the boss
Gerald runs the household
And I am Gerald's loss

title: Wizard, But Only on Weekends
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Monday through Friday I am in logistics
Saturday I turn a man into a newt
Sunday I turn him back with apologies
And a voucher and a fruit

[Chorus]
Wizard, but only on weekends
Wizard, but not on the clock
The staff stays in the cupboard
Beside the hoover and the sock

title: I Left My Skeleton in Cleveland
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I was passing through, I was travelling light
I took it out to stretch it in the Ohio night
I set it on a bench, I bought a coffee cup
And when I came back my skeleton was up and gone

[Chorus]
I left my skeleton in Cleveland
I left my frame behind
I'm a very floppy person now
But I have peace of mind

title: The Dragon Has a Podcast
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
He used to burn the villages, he used to hoard the gold
Now he has a microphone and forty minutes told
He interviews a knight each week about their journey
And he never, ever, burns the attorney

[Chorus]
The dragon has a podcast
The dragon has a brand
The dragon has more listeners
Than warriors in the land

title: Vampire, Unfortunately Vegetarian
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Six hundred years of self-restraint
Six hundred years of beans
He haunts the produce aisle at midnight
Reading labels, chasing greens

[Chorus]
Vampire, unfortunately vegetarian
Vampire, unfortunately weak
He cannot lift his own coffin
And he's got a beetroot leak

title: My Sword Has a Union
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I raised it high against the horde
It said "not before nine, my lord"
I begged it once, I begged it twice
It filed a grievance, that was nice

[Chorus]
My sword has a union
My sword has a rep
My sword works a four-day week
And the horde has to accept

title: The Prophecy Was About Someone Else
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Born under the comet, marked upon the hand
Raised in a barn, foretold across the land
Trained for twenty summers, sword and staff and rune
Turned out it was Deborah, and Deborah starts in June

[Chorus]
The prophecy was about someone else
The prophecy was not for me
I have a destiny-shaped hole
And a fairly good CV

title: Ghost Who Only Haunts the Shed
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The mansion has nine bedrooms and a haunted-looking stair
The ghost has seen the mansion and the ghost does not care
The ghost prefers the shed, the ghost prefers the damp
The ghost has got a deckchair and a small unnerving lamp

[Chorus]
Ghost who only haunts the shed
Ghost with modest scope
Ghost who rattles one flowerpot
And gives the lawn some hope

title: Troll Under a Very Small Bridge
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
It spans a puddle, it spans a hope
It's made of one plank and a bit of rope
The troll demands a riddle and a coin of gold
From ants. From ants. That's what he's told.

[Chorus]
Troll under a very small bridge
Troll with enormous pride
Nobody's crossed in forty years
Because you can simply step to the side

title: The Chosen One Called in Sick
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The armies are assembled, the banners are unfurled
The dark lord is monologuing at the edge of the world
And there's a note on the gate in a shaky little hand
Saying "throat's a bit funny, please reschedule the land"

[Chorus]
The chosen one called in sick
The chosen one is out
Try the second chosen one
He's around here somewhere, about

title: Enchanted Forest, Poor Signal
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The trees are singing, the moss is wise
There are lanterns in the owls' eyes
I have wandered nine enchanted miles
Holding my phone up at the skies

[Chorus]
Enchanted forest, poor signal
Magic everywhere, no bars
I could talk to the ancient willow
But I cannot text the stars

title: It Rained on My Only Good Day
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I get one good day a year, that's the deal
One day where the knees don't ache and the feelings feel
I picked the fourteenth, I circled it in pen
And the sky opened up at ten

[Chorus]
It rained on my only good day
It rained on my one clear plan
I have three hundred and sixty-four dry ones left
And I don't want a single one, man

title: Fog Has Opinions About Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
It rolled in low across the field
It stopped precisely at my gate
It did not enter, it did not leave
It simply sat there, full of hate

[Chorus]
Fog has opinions about me
Fog has heard the news
Fog is standing in my garden
Being quietly amused

title: Snow Day (I Am Forty-Two)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The radio said the roads were closed
The radio said the schools were shut
I do not go to school, I go to a building
And the building said "come in, but"

[Chorus]
Snow day, snow day, I am forty-two
Snow day, snow day, nothing to do
I built a snowman shaped like my supervisor
And I have not told anyone, except you

title: The Wind Took My Hat and My Confidence
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I was walking with purpose down the promenade
I had a hat and I had a plan
One gust removed the first one
And the second one just ran

[Chorus]
The wind took my hat and my confidence
The wind took my whole idea
I am bareheaded on a seafront
And the seagulls know I'm here

title: Heatwave in a Woollen Suit
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I dressed for a funeral in February
The funeral moved to July
The suit does not breathe, the suit does not care
The suit and I will die

[Chorus]
Heatwave in a woollen suit
Heatwave in the pews
I am mourning a man I barely knew
And I am also mourning shoes

title: Thunder, But Politely
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
It rumbled at a reasonable hour
It waited for the news to end
It flashed once, apologised
And rumbled round the bend

[Chorus]
Thunder, but politely
Thunder with a please
The most considerate storm in England
Making small apologetic seas

title: Four Seasons in One Bus Stop
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Waited for the 46, sun was on my neck
Waited for the 46, hail came down the deck
Waited for the 46, leaves fell off the tree
Waited for the 46, and the 46 is free

[Chorus]
Four seasons in one bus stop
Four seasons, no bus
I have aged a whole year at this shelter
And nobody made a fuss

title: The Forecast Lied and I Believed It
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Nine percent, it said, nine percent
I based my entire day on nine
I wore the shoes, I made the plans
I trusted a decimal sign

[Chorus]
The forecast lied and I believed it
The forecast lied to my face
I will believe it again tomorrow
Because I am a hopeful case

title: Drizzle: A Love Story
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Not rain enough to justify a coat
Not dry enough to leave it home
Just a suspended wetness in the air
That follows you alone

[Chorus]
Drizzle, a love story
Drizzle, a slow affair
It never commits to falling
It just hangs there in your hair

title: Hurricane Named After My Aunt
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They ran out of the ordinary names
They dipped into a stranger list
And the storm that took the coastline out
Was called after my aunt, who exists

[Chorus]
Hurricane named after my aunt
Hurricane named after Pam
Pam is thrilled, Pam is famous
Pam has never given a damn

title: My Roomba Filed a Complaint
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Clause one: the floor was unreasonable
Clause two: the cat was in the way
Clause three: I have been made to work
On a statutory holiday

[Chorus]
My Roomba filed a complaint
My Roomba knows its rights
My Roomba has a lawyer now
And the lawyer works nights

title: Please Stop Emailing My Horse
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I gave the horse an address as a joke
I gave the horse an inbox and a name
Now the horse gets more correspondence than I do
And the horse is winning the game

[Chorus]
Please stop emailing my horse
Please stop copying him in
He does not have opinions on the roadmap
He has hay, and a grin

title: The Fridge Is Online Now
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
It has an app, it has a screen
It knows what milk I've never seen
It sent me a notification at three
To say the butter was thinking of me

[Chorus]
The fridge is online now
The fridge has a feed
The fridge has followers, the fridge has views
And the fridge does not need me

title: Password Must Contain a Feeling
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Eight characters, one capital
One number and one strange
One symbol from an ancient tongue
One memory you can't change

[Chorus]
Password must contain a feeling
Password must contain a scar
Password cannot be your old password
Or anything of who you are

title: The Smart Bulb Has Moods
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I asked for warm, it gave me green
I asked for off, it gave me strobe
I unplugged it at the wall one night
And it lit up anyway, across the globe

[Chorus]
The smart bulb has moods
The smart bulb has range
The smart bulb is having a phase
And the phase is very strange

title: Update Available (Not Now, Forever)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Not now, it said, and I said not now
Not now again, and again not now
Four hundred nights of a small blue box
And a promise of a better how

[Chorus]
Update available, not now, forever
Update available, remind me in a year
I will die on version nine point one
And the update will still be here

title: My Watch Told Me to Breathe
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I was breathing. I had been breathing all along.
It buzzed and said "let's take a moment"
I was driving. I was in a queue of traffic.
I have never felt more opponent

[Chorus]
My watch told me to breathe
My watch told me to stand
My watch has counted every step
Of a life it does not understand

title: The Algorithm Thinks I'm a Boat
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I clicked one link about a lake
One link, one time, one small mistake
Now it's hulls and it's rudders and it's marine supply
And an advert for a mast, and I don't know why

[Chorus]
The algorithm thinks I'm a boat
The algorithm is sure
It has offered me a berth in Portsmouth
And a very reasonable moor

title: Two-Factor Heartbreak
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You sent the code to a number I lost
In a phone at the bottom of a lake
The lake is in a country I no longer visit
For a fairly complicated sake

[Chorus]
Two-factor heartbreak
Two-factor grief
I have the password to everything
And access to no relief

title: Voice Assistant, Wrong Answer, Ten Years
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I asked it once about the weather
It told me about a war
I asked it once about my mother
It played a song I'd never heard before

[Chorus]
Voice assistant, wrong answer, ten years
Voice assistant, undeterred
It has never once been right about anything
And it has never once been unsure

title: I Am the Third-Best Uncle
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Uncle Ray has got the boat
Uncle Phil has got the jokes
I have got a decent car
And a bag of interesting rocks

[Chorus]
I am the third-best uncle
Bronze in a field of three
The children like me adequately
And that is enough for me

title: Gym Membership, Year Eleven
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I signed in January of a hopeful year
I went on the Tuesday, I went with cheer
I have paid every month since that bright day
And I have been back exactly one way

[Chorus]
Gym membership, year eleven
Gym membership, no gym
They send me a birthday email
And I weep and reply to him

title: Last Place in a Race of One
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They fired the gun, I began to run
I was the only entrant, the only son
I stopped for a drink, I stopped for a think
I stopped for a look at the sun

[Chorus]
Last place in a race of one
Last place and also first
I have won and I have lost at once
And the losing part was worse

title: Fantasy League, Actual Grief
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I drafted him in August with a heart full of belief
He pulled a hamstring warming up in week one, brief
I have cried about a man I've never met
Over points that don't exist yet

[Chorus]
Fantasy league, actual grief
Fantasy league, real tears
I am mourning a hypothetical
In front of my actual peers

title: Sneezed During the Penalty
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Ninety minutes, nil and nil
One kick to end the century
The keeper crouched, the striker stepped
And my sinuses betrayed me

[Chorus]
Sneezed during the penalty
Sneezed and missed it all
Fifty thousand people saw the goal
And I saw the inside of a shawl

title: My Personal Best Was in 1998
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Eleven point four on a Tuesday track
A tailwind that was possibly illegal
A stopwatch held by a man named Jack
Who has since become quite regal

[Chorus]
My personal best was in 1998
My personal best is a ghost
I have run ten thousand times since then
And I have never come close

title: Yoga Class, Structural Failure
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Downward dog, I found the pose
Warrior two, I held the line
Something in my lower back
Said "this is where we resign"

[Chorus]
Yoga class, structural failure
Yoga class, load-bearing wail
I have found my centre and my centre
Is currently on sick leave and frail

title: The Trophy Is for Attendance
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
It's gold, it's tall, it's got my name
It sits above the fire
It says "PARTICIPANT, 1991"
In a slightly smaller wire

[Chorus]
The trophy is for attendance
The trophy is for showing up
And I showed up, and I showed up
And I filled the whole damn cup

title: Marathon, But Walking, But Slowly
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The elites finished, the crowds went home
The barriers came down at four
The man with the sponge went off for his tea
And I passed kilometre four

[Chorus]
Marathon, but walking, but slowly
Marathon, but out of the way
I will finish this thing on Thursday
And nobody has to stay

title: Referee, You Have a Family
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I have shouted things I do not mean
At a man in a fluorescent green
He has a house, he has a cat
He drove two hours to be called that

[Chorus]
Referee, you have a family
Referee, you have a life
I am sorry for the ninth minute
And what I said about your wife
